summary.zh-CN: 新会话会恢复每个 Agent Runtime 最近使用的模型，并改进上下文压缩反馈与消息连续性。
summary.en-US: New chats restore each Agent Runtime's recent model, with clearer context compaction feedback and stronger message continuity.

title.zh-CN: 按 Agent Runtime 恢复模型

body.zh-CN: 在全新会话中切换 Agent Runtime 时，会恢复用户最近为该 Runtime 选择的模型。
body.en-US: Switching Agent Runtimes in a new chat restores the model most recently selected for that runtime.

body.zh-CN: 手动压缩上下文后会立即显示进行中状态，并在请求结束后正确清理。
body.en-US: Manual context compaction shows immediate progress and clears it correctly when the request finishes.

body.zh-CN: 发送的消息会立即出现，实时连接恢复后也会自动补回遗漏内容。
body.en-US: Sent messages appear immediately, and missed content is recovered after a realtime reconnect.

body.zh-CN: 现有 NPM 安装可以直接通过 stable 通道升级，不需要迁移配置、会话或文件。
body.en-US: Existing npm installations can update through the stable channel without migrating configuration, sessions, or files.
